decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has its own web page and builds directly on the firm's long-standing formulation knowledge in cosmetic chemicals, so it can read the early market feedback and improve the line.
A hyaluronic acid serum is a standard active formulation close to the firm's existing expertise, so it stays despite its modest web presence and a crowded market.
A cleansing milk is a basic emulsion that fits the firm's existing know-how and costs little to keep, though its brief mention online points to low priority.
